title: Russia imports record fuel from India as Ukraine strikes hit refineries
summary: Russia imported record oil products from India in August.  This surge occurred as Ukrainian drone strikes disrupted domestic refining capacity.  India supplied seventy percent of Russia's oil product imports during this period.  These shipments underscore the impact of sustained Ukrainian drone campaigns.  Russia's fossil-fuel export revenues saw a decline in August.

title: Inside NSE IPO journey: Why India's largest exchange took 10 long years to reach Dalal Street
summary: After nearly a decade of delays, NSE is finally set to enter the public markets with its IPO. From the co-location controversy to the Supreme Court settlement, several regulatory and legal hurdles had delayed NSE’s market debut.

title: Insolvency regulator mulls tighter safeguards for personal guarantee insolvency
summary: India’s insolvency regulator is proposing tighter safeguards for personal guarantor cases, including zero voting rights for related-party creditors, independent asset valuations and scrutiny of questionable transactions. Creditors may also have to explain why a repayment plan offers a better outcome than bankruptcy, particularly when recoveries are low.
